name: Sony DualSense
controls: Left X: steer | R2/L2: drive with trigger-pressure rumble scaled by speed mode | D-pad Up/Down: speed mode 1-3 with rumble and white LED brightness | reverse: green/white LED cycle and DualSense speaker beep | L1: brake | R1: boost with delayed strong rumble and orange LED; unavailable boost flashes red | Square: manual front lights | Circle: 1s flicker signal | auto: front forward, rockets reverse blink
